122800: Ange is a genius spy with artistic skills. She is adept in telling lies and she can tell when someone is lying to her. She also possesses a special device that allows her to fly for short periods of time. Despite her lying nature, Ange can be shown to be a nice and kind person
122801: A noblewoman who serves as Princess' aide and close friend. She can mimic voices of other people using a mechanism that her father implanted in her throat. Her father has treated her as a test subject for his experiments.
122802: An exchange student from Japan. She is highly proficient in samurai-style swordsmanship. She often acts naive and has a hard time adapting to the culture differences.
122803: An undercover student. She is actually 20 years old and acts as a leader to the spies. She is good at shooting, seducing and driving vehicles.
122804: The niece of the Duke of Normandy and a princess of Albion Kingdom who is fourth in the line of succession for the throne. She has an oddball personality, but she gets along well with others.
122805: Adjutant to the Albion Kingdom's Chief of Internal Affairs, Duke of Normandy. She is usually tasked with doing subterfuge, assassination, spycraft, and anything that requires discretion for her employer. She is also sometimes assigned to guard duty for the royal family.
123068: The head of Control, Commonwealth's intelligence department. He appears to be a man in his forty.
123069: The head of Albion Kingdom's Internal Affairs Office and a relative to the royal family. He also served as a mentor to the crown prince, teaching him many things about ruling as a king to prepare for his ascension.
123533: A handler in Control, the Commonwealth's intelligence department tasked with issuing command and assisting the spies working for the Commonwealth in Albion. She mostly acts as a liaison to the White Pigeon Team.
